entities.title: Display, font and keys
entities.summary: The font covers what the game prints, the display renders as the Spectrum does, and keys reach the game as typed.
criteria: The font covers printable ASCII plus £ and ©; glyphs are distinct and capitals keep the top row clear
Print draws glyph pixels and sets attributes; pictures plot '#' as ink
Render paints border, paper and ink, and FLASH swaps ink and paper
Normal colours are 0xD7, BRIGHT 0xFF, black stays black
Every drawing call changes the version, so the display redraws
Keys reach the game as typed: case kept, Enter and Space kept, others ignored
